origins: January 1 + multiples of 15 days, retain only targets ending in the specified calendar year; all seven start weekdays required

ibm.split_hash: sha256('forecast-v1:' + str(User)), full digest as integer divided by 2**256
ibm.eligible: At least one qualifying transaction on or before context start; missing transaction dates after that are assumed observed zeros, an unverified completeness assumption
ibm.amount_policy: Keep positive successful card charges; count and exclude nonpositive/refund rows and rows with nonempty Errors?; retain exact duplicate rows (no unique event identifier). Fraud annotation is never a feature or exclusion.

moneydata.currency_note: Pre-training amendment: author sheet does not explicitly establish currency. UK context suggests GBP but is not treated as verified. Use native units and block currency-dependent integration.
moneydata.group_key: single-person case study, temporal splits only
moneydata.eligible: 56 days within published observation span; absent posted dates assumed observed zeros
moneydata.amount_policy: Gross positive Debit Amount; no bill exclusion and no offsetting credits; retain exact duplicates; source archives weekend transactions on Monday

features: 56 scaled daily lags; 14 future weekday historical means; 14 future weekday sine; 14 cosine; log1p(history-only scale). scale=max(last28mean,1 major currency unit). Total99. Train-only feature standardization, sd floor0.1.
ridge_objective: normalized daily squared error; intercept unpenalized; clip negative predictions to zero

neural.loss: mean squared error of history-scale-normalized daily amounts
neural.selection: lowest validation 14-day-total MAE across epoch checkpoints and seeds

bootstrap.moneydata_unit: circular blocks of 4 consecutive forecast origins (~60 days), one individual only

final_holdout: Evaluate after validation selection; no further tuning on final results. Disclose any bug-fix rerun. No real-world promotion from these fallbacks.
